title: Claude Code Live: Origin story, demos, and best practices
description: Join the creators of Claude Code for a behind-the-scenes look at Anthropic's first AI agent. In this technical session, you'll hear directly from the creators of Claude Code about its development journey and the challenges overcome. We’ll also dive into demos of Claude Code in action, showcasing best practices for bringing Claude Code into existing workflows and how to use it in real codebases.
